g.data-exception-reason: Explicit single-height dot alternatives are derived from the shared continuous geometry inside each master. Plate and vessel dot rows follow contour centrelines;1.2mm circles have0.4mm less outer reach than2mm swell strokes. Fork perimeter circles extend0.6mm outside the silhouette and reduce the nominal4mm slots to2.8mm clear at the dot edges; this is a deliberate provisional sampling allowance. Saucepan filled handle is sampled separately and shares its attachment row with the vessel wall, avoiding duplicate dots.

g.data-design-reason: Continuous geometry is shared unchanged. Plate has a lower area across its whole disk under two higher circular boundaries; this distinguishes a plate surface from a through-hole without inventing a third height or perspective. Saucepan vessel has a lower filled area beneath the higher outline, with its solid handle higher. Fork retains one high silhouette to preserve four tines and three open slots. Height choices are explicit per-concept decisions, not automatic semantic-tag mappings.
